from typing import Literal
import mas_operators as operator
from . import prompt as prompt_custom
from scripts.async_llm import create_llm_instance


from scripts.evaluator import DatasetType

class Workflow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        llm_config,
        dataset: DatasetType,
        aggregator_llm_config=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.llm = create_llm_instance(llm_config)
        self.aggregator_llm = create_llm_instance(aggregator_llm_config) if aggregator_llm_config else self.llm

    async def __call__(self, problem: str):
        star = operator.Star(worker_llm=self.llm, aggregator_llm=self.aggregator_llm, num_agents=4, worker_prompts=[prompt_custom.DECIPHER_STAR_AGENT] * 4, aggregator_prompt=prompt_custom.DECIPHER_STAR_PASS)
        draft = await star(problem)
        debate = operator.Debate(worker_llm=self.aggregator_llm, aggregator_llm=self.aggregator_llm, num_agents=3, worker_prompts=[prompt_custom.DECIPHER_DEBATE_AGENT] * 3, aggregator_prompt=prompt_custom.DECIPHER_DEBATE_AGG, n_rounds=2)
        judged = await debate(problem + "\n\nInitial candidates:\n" + draft["response"])
        seq = operator.Sequential(llm=self.aggregator_llm, num_rounds=1, prompts=[prompt_custom.DECIPHER_FINAL_EXTRACT])
        solution = await seq(judged["response"])
        return solution["response"], {"worker": self.llm.get_usage_delta(), "aggregator": self.aggregator_llm.get_usage_delta()}

- Infer the cipher transformation from the hint pair, then apply it to the target ciphertext.
